reviewer: Codex AI visual diagnostic, not human review
method: All 144 images inspected on 24 shuffled A-F contact sheets, with 32px thumbnails. Condition map withheld until this observation file was complete. Development prompts, not a sealed test; subjective ordinal scores, not calibrated probabilities.

scoring.2: Major requested details clearly present, no obvious material defect
scoring.1: Recognizable but missing/ambiguous requested detail or uncertain geometry
scoring.0: Major prompt failure or clearly defective geometry
